'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2021 Afghanistan–Iran clashes]]
**Clashes occur between the [[Taliban]] and [[Iran]] on the [[Afghanistan–Iran border]] after Iranian farmers crossed the border. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-12-01/iran-forces-and-taliban-clashed-on-afghan-border-tasnim-says (Bloomberg)]
* [[Mexican drug war]]
** [[2021 Tula prison break]]
*** Armed cartel members break into a prison in [[Tula, Hidalgo|Tula]], [[Hidalgo (state)|Hidalgo]] using vehicles, [[detonating]] several [[car bomb]]s. Nine inmates are freed, including a local [[drug lord]]. Two law enforcement officers are injured. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/dec/01/mexico-prison-break-car-bombs (''The Guardian'')]
* [[Porga attack]]
** Two soldiers are killed and others are wounded during an attack at a security post by [[Islamic extremism|Islamic extremists]] in [[Porga, Benin]]. It is the second confirmed [[Islamic extremist]] attack in the country's history. [https://news.yahoo.com/two-benin-soldiers-killed-jihadist-173303672.html (Yahoo! News)] 

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Bagwai boat disaster]]
**At least 29 people, mostly schoolchildren, drown after an overloaded boat [[capsize]]s in [[Bagwai]], [[Kano State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-59490699 (BBC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Japan]]
****[[Japan]] begins administering [[booster dose]]s of the [[COVID-19 vaccine]] to [[healthcare worker]]s amid growing concerns over the Omicron variant that has already been detected in the country. [https://www.independent.co.uk/asia/japan/japan-covid-vaccine-booster-omicron-b1967430.html (''The Independent'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Saudi Arabia]]
****[[Saudi Arabia]] reports its first case of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant]] in a citizen who travelled from [[North Africa]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/coronavirus/2021/12/01/Saudi-Arabia-detects-first-case-of-COVID-19-Omicron-variant-in-Kingdom (Al Arabiya)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]]
****[[South Korea]] reports a record 5,123 new cases of [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 452,530. [https://www.cnbc.com/2021/12/01/south-korea-reports-daily-record-of-over-5000-new-covid-19-infections.html (CNBC)]
****South Korea reports its first five cases of the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant in a fully vaccinated couple who travelled from [[Nigeria]] and later tested positive, along with two of their family members and a friend. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/south-korea-confirms-first-cases-of-omicron (''The Straits Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Arab Emirates]]
****The [[United Arab Emirates]] reports its first case of the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant in a citizen who travelled from [[Africa]]. [https://gulfnews.com/amp/uae/covid-19-uae-reports-first-omicron-case-1.1638385214909 (''Gulf News'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Andorra]]
****The Andorran government announces a ten-day quarantine for all travelers coming from southern Africa countries. [https://www.diariandorra.ad/noticies/nacional/2021/12/01/quarantena_obligatoria_per_qui_provingui_paisos_africa_del_sud_191363_1125.html (''Diari d'Andorra'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Denmark]]
****[[Denmark]] reports a record 5,120 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours. [https://news.yahoo.com/denmark-reports-record-daily-covid-133818772.html (Yahoo! News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iceland]]
****[[Iceland]] reports its first case of the Omicron variant. [https://icelandmonitor.mbl.is/news/news/2021/12/02/iceland_s_first_case_of_omicron_variant_confirmed/ (''Morgunblaðið'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Republic of Ireland]]
****[[Republic of Ireland|Ireland]] reports its first case of the Omicron variant in a person who recently travelled from southern Africa. [https://www.irishtimes.com/news/ireland/irish-news/blind-luck-finds-first-case-of-omicron-variant-in-ireland-nphet-says-1.4743877 (''The Irish Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Italy]] reports 103 deaths of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, making it the deadliest toll since June 8. [https://www.ilsole24ore.com/art/coronavirus-ultime-notizie-italia-15085-nuovi-casi-e-103-morti-AErxaK0 (''Il Sole 24ore'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Poland]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Poland]]
****[[Poland|Polish]] [[Prime Minister of Poland|prime minister]] [[Mateusz Morawiecki]] receives a [[booster dose]] of the [[COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://www.newindianexpress.com/world/2021/dec/01/poland-pm-mateusz-morawiecki%E2%80%8B-urges-covid-vaccinations-as-deaths-rise-2390555.html (''The New Indian Express'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in California]]
*****The [[United States]] reports its first case of the Omicron variant in a person who travelled from [[South Africa]] to [[California]]. [https://www.cnn.com/world/live-news/omicron-covid-19-variant-12-01-21/index.html (CNN)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mexico]], [[COVID-19 drug development]]
****[[Mexico|Mexican]] health regulator [[Federal Commission for the Protection against Sanitary Risk|COFEPRIS]] approves the emergency use of [[Eli Lilly and Company]]'s injectable combination of [[bamlanivimab]] and [[etesevimab]] to treat mild to moderate COVID-19 cases in people over the age of 12 years who weigh at least {{cvt|40|kg}}. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-lilly-mexico/mexico-approves-emergency-use-of-lillys-covid-19-treatment-idUSKBN2IG4NQ (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ghana]]
****[[Ghana]] reports its first case of the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant in a traveller who arrived at [[Kotoka International Airport]] in [[Accra]]. [https://www.theeastafrican.co.ke/tea/rest-of-africa/covid-19-ghana-records-first-cases-of-omicron-variant-3637846 (''The EastAfrican'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Zimbabwe]]
****[[Zimbabwe]] announces a nine-hour curfew and compulsory 14-day [[quarantine]] for anyone arriving in the country, to prevent the spread of the Omicron variant, becoming the first country in southern Africa to enact such restrictions. [https://www.voanews.com/a/zimbabwe-quarantine-curfew-omicron/6335368.html (VOA)]
*Aftermath of [[COP26]]
**[[President of the Federated States of Micronesia|Micronesian president]] [[David W. Panuelo]] condemns the outcome of the climate summit, stating that [[Developed country|industrialized nations]] must increase their commitments in order to help countries switch from [[fossil fuel]]s to [[renewable energy]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/cop/pacific-island-leaders-bemoan-weak-glasgow-climate-pact-2021-12-01/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 Australian Parliament House sexual misconduct allegations]]
**Former [[Attorney-General of Australia]] [[Christian Porter]] announces he will retire from politics following [[sexual assault]] allegations published earlier in the year, and controversy surrounding his reliance on a [[blind trust]] in a legal battle against the [[Australian Broadcasting Corporation]] over their reporting of the allegations. [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2021/dec/01/christian-porter-bemoans-harshness-of-politics-as-he-announces-hell-quit-parliament (''The Guardian'')]
